name: chatprd
description: ChatPRD MCP connector — push PRDs, feature specs and FriskyClaw ops digests into ChatPRD via OAuth (no API key)
author: Local developer
skillInstructions: OAuth for this connector approves only email and profile. Do not approve private_metadata, public_metadata, offline_access, or user:org:read.

interface.shortDescription: Push PRDs and FriskyClaw digests into ChatPRD
interface.longDescription: Official ChatPRD MCP connector (OAuth, no API key). Use it to push PRDs, feature specs, and the twice-daily FriskyClaw ops rollup into ChatPRD, and to read back PRD status.
